rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a calm, even-tempered person or disposition.

example.english: They are always equable and never lose their temper.

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something remaining steady and not fluctuating.

example.english: Business has been slow lately, but our income has been fairly equable.

rows.note: Use this for mild weather or a temperature without uncomfortable extremes.

example.english: The weather this winter has been equable, neither cold nor hot.
